subject: [PATCH 33/60] cgroup/cpuset: ignore private nodes when matching OOM victims

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch addresses a valid issue with the OOM killer's handling of private nodes. However, it is unclear whether this change will have any significant impact on system behavior or performance.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses an issue where the OOM killer incorrectly considers tasks on private nodes as eligible victims, leading to potential memory leaks. The fix involves modifying the cpuset_mems_allowed_intersects function to ignore private nodes when determining intersection of mems_allowed. This change ensures that only common memory pressure is taken into account by the OOM killer.
